items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex down 400 pts, Nifty below 23,400; Nifty Metal down 1%
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Friday: At pre-open, the Nifty50 and the Sensex declined. Most Asian markets extended losses

items.title: Newly-listed companies add ₹32-trillion to BSE market-cap in 2026
items.description: Of these, Jio Platform alone contributed 41 per cent or ₹12.85 trillion in market cap, while NSE accounted for a 17 per cent or 5.42 trillion addition to the total market-cap.

items.title: Anthropic founders' combined wealth jumps to $166 bn after record IPO
items.description: Each founder holds an estimated 1.3 per cent stake in the AI company, putting their individual fortunes at about $24 billion after shares closed at $97.17, above the $83 offer price

items.title: Anthropic becomes world's 7th most valuable company with $1.8 trn valuation
items.description: The AI company closed 17 per cent above its offer price, reaching a fully diluted market value of $1.8 trillion and placing it ahead of Saudi Aramco, Broadcom and TSMC

items.title: Anthropic's IPO turns tech researchers into overnight millionaires
items.description: Many people who joined the AI company a few years ago might have had little reason to think how big Anthropic would become. They are now worth tens of millions of dollars, if not more

items.title: Anthropic pares IPO gains as shares slide 5% in after-hours trading
items.description: The stock's post-market decline followed a 17 per cent debut gain, as concerns over its steep valuation and competition weighed on sentiment amid a broader global equities sell-off
